none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a globally differentiable, L-smooth objective F that may be nonconvex. A global minimizer xstar satisfies ‖xstar−x0‖≤R. Convexity of F itself and strong convexity are not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: spec.admissible, gradient smoothness and global-minimizer clauses.

problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Local hidden convexity: F=H∘c on ball(x0,3R), where H is convex and differentiable on an open convex set U. For x∈closedBall(x0,2R), c(x)∈U and Dc(x)=J(x).
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: Instance and spec.admissible, composition, ConvexOn, DifferentiableAt, and HasFDerivAt clauses.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns g(x,ξ)∈E with Eξ[g(x,ξ)]=∇F(x) and Eξ‖g(x,ξ)−∇F(x)‖²≤σ² for every x. Fresh seeds are independent with a common probability law. The oracle supplies gradients only; function values, c, H, and J are unavailable. The supplied budget counts individual oracle replies and is a fixed call cap.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible oracle construction; LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: StochasticGradient.IsStochasticGradient; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform variance bound σ²≥0 on the squared norm of the unbiased gradient error, with joint measurability and the stated integrability conditions. No almost-sure error bound, tail bound, or sample-gradient smoothness is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/StochasticSmoothAndConvex.lean: StochasticGradient.IsStochasticGradient.measurable, integrable, unbiased, variance_integrable, and variance; LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and second-countable topology. No dimension bound is supplied.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: Public.finiteE, Public.linearE, Public.completeE, Public.borelE, and Public.countableE.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The hidden Jacobian satisfies ‖J(x)v‖≥μ‖v‖ and ‖J(x)−J(y)‖≤LJ‖x−y‖ on closedBall(x0,2R), with μ>0, LJ≥0, and 32LJ R≤μ. Public information includes L>0, R>0, σ≥0, and x0. The structural parameters μ,LJ and target ε>0 are hidden from the algorithm constructor; ε can determine the execution budget.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible Jacobian clauses; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and execute.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued point X with integrable objective gap F(X)−F(xstar), where xstar is a global minimizer. No feasibility region or particular iterate is imposed on the output.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[F(X)−F(xstar)]≤ε, with expectation over the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. No high-probability or almost-sure accuracy guarantee is required.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalHiddenConvexStochastic.lean: spec.successful integral inequality; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines stochastic gradient access with a hidden convex representation available only locally, quantitative control of its Jacobian variation, and structural parameters withheld from the algorithm.
